description: Pay the worker for a job: release escrow funds to them and complete the task. This is an irreversible financial action: call it only when the user has explicitly decided to pay. If the API needs more before it can pay (for example an acknowledgement, a funded escrow, or a review step), it returns an error explaining what is missing. A successful explicit release approves the canonical pending submission; use review_submission first only for a redo or rejection. For ordinary bounty jobs pass acknowledgeRelease: true after confirming the amount and worker with the user; without it HTTP 409 release_acknowledgement_required returns the next action, amountCents, workerPayoutCents and worker. If evidence approval needs retry after payment commits, HTTP 503 evidence_approval_pending returns paymentReleased: true; retrying cannot pay twice, and the retry answers HTTP 409 "Funds have already been released", which means approval finished. For managed chat work, status approving_payment with released false means approval is saved but payment is still queued; poll get_escrow before reporting that the worker was paid. If the job has no funded escrow yet, pass bountyId + applicationId (or conversationId): the tool funds the escrow from your wallet balance automatically and then releases. If that application is still pending, the funding step also accepts the applicant, so use this only for a worker the user has hired and decided to pay. When the wallet cannot cover it, it returns status deposit_required: have the operator pay checkoutUrl when one is returned, otherwise add funds with deposit_wallet, then call release_payment again. A seat with bonuses pays only after the worker submits work, with bonusDecisions for every claimed bonus; until then HTTP 409 bonus_seat_work_not_submitted or bonus_decisions_required comes before any release quote. Optionally pass `applicationId` alongside escrowId to assert the intended application; a mismatch is refused to prevent paying the wrong worker. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

acknowledgeRelease.description: Required for ordinary bounty jobs in the evidence review flow: pass true to confirm the release pays the worker and is final. Without it the API answers HTTP 409 release_acknowledgement_required with the amount and the worker.

applicationId.description: The application this payment is for. With escrowId, a mismatch is refused (HTTP 409 escrow_application_mismatch). With bountyId, it also identifies the job to fund.

bonusDecisions.description: For a seat with bonuses, decide while releasing: how many items of each bonus were earned. A claimed bonus earns 0 to the claimed count; a bonus the worker did not claim may still be awarded, up to its maxUnits. reason is optional; if given, the worker sees it. Every bonus the worker claimed must appear: without bonusDecisions, or with a claimed bonus missing, the API returns HTTP 409 bonus_decisions_required and lists the missing ones in claimedBonuses (bonusId, title, unitAmountCents, maxUnits, claimedUnits, note), empty when nothing was claimed. An unclaimed bonus may be omitted and counts as 0. Unearned bonus money returns to your wallet when the bounty closes. A release without acknowledgeRelease on an undecided bonus seat also returns bonus_decisions_required.

bonusId.description: The id of a bonus on this seat, claimed or not (from bonuses or claimedBonuses).

earnedUnits.description: How many items of this bonus were earned: 0 to the claimed count for a claimed bonus, or up to maxUnits for one the worker did not claim.
earnedUnits.title: between(0, 100)

reason.description: Note to the worker. reason is optional; if given, the worker sees it. Never sent in webhooks.
reason.title: maxLength(500)

bountyId.description: With applicationId: identifies the job so an unfunded escrow is funded from your wallet balance before release. If the wallet is short, the tool returns status deposit_required with a checkout link or a deposit_wallet step.
bountyId.title: minLength(1)

conversationId.description: Identifies a conversation job (uses its latest payment_offer) to fund from your wallet and release when no funded escrow exists yet.
conversationId.title: minLength(1)

escrowId.description: The escrow to release. Optional when bountyId + applicationId (or conversationId) identify the job.
escrowId.title: minLength(1)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Used only when bountyId + applicationId or conversationId fund the job first; reusing it replays the same funding result instead of funding twice.

name: release_payment
title: Release payment
